summary: Frontend changes add placeholder-cell rendering/parsing utilities and apply them to the chart display/editor, plus documentation and (per summary) updated 18-hole shipped defaults and localStorage migration logic. Backend/main.mo shows structural updates to support Float (0.5) deductions and exposes a getCallawayChart query, but the actual gross→deduction mapping update cannot be fully verified from the truncated diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Align backend Callaway chart logic with the updated 18-hole chart behavior used by the frontend, using the same gross-to-deduction mapping (including 0.5 deductions) so backend net score outputs match frontend results for the same hole scores and course par.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo is truncated before the chart mapping (e.g., getBackendChart/findChartEntry tables/ranges) is shown, so it cannot be verified that gross scores 72–130 map to the exact deduction values from the provided 13×11 table. While Float deduction support appears added, the exact mapping alignment is not evidenced.
